title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1973-12-12
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: A crisp Charlie Miller soundboard captures a solid 73‑minute 1973 show with standout renditions of Blue Suede Shoes, Peggy‑O and Half‑Step.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise the strong, overlooked 1973 performance and note that the Miller soundboard recording is clear and powerful, especially the soundcheck. Highlights include bluesy numbers like Blue Suede Shoes and folk gems such as Peggy‑O, making the set both tight and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑star overall ratings and highlighted excellent sound quality (5 stars for recording) plus solid playing, leading to a weighted average around 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note a crisp, strong soundcheck and overall clear mix; no issues or drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise 73‑minute set that moves smoothly through blues, folk and rock numbers, delivering solid playing throughout.
